game.name: TrackWerk
game.desc: TrackWerk 0.2.0-beta.3 by Kid Bunka — independent GPL music studio for TrimUI Brick / KNULLI. Project swing, internal post-FX resampling, categorized effect/master libraries, branded materials, synthesis, sample editing, online digging, Drumlab and Punch. Earlier musical workflows user-tested; current-beta hardware acceptance remains open. Direct iPhone recording failed in the current user setup; interfaces are separately untested.
